mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI annualized growth > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with negative 5-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods despite negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with negative 60-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past 3 months signals weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or HOUST decrease > 5% does not correlate with negative 60-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease > 25bps does not correlate with positive 5-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Real GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and UNRATE decreases in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with positive 60-day returns (p > 0.05).
